vectors.name: Data Fabric outage does not block standard connection
vectors.expect: wallet.connection.established may be queued later; connection behavior has no synchronous Data Fabric dependency

vectors.name: Broker outage retains observation
vectors.expect: canonical event remains in Outbox with bounded retry and no wallet-side business retry

vectors.name: Broker recovery is idempotent
vectors.expect: one Inbox effect despite duplicate publication

vectors.name: Out-of-order event is contained
vectors.expect: ordered aggregate policy rejects or requeues the observation without changing connection state

vectors.name: Consumer crash and restart
vectors.expect: Inbox marker and aggregate effect are atomic; replay has no duplicate business effect

vectors.name: Product Session revoke differs from wallet revoke
Retired client
vectors.expect: client.retired.connection_rejected is recorded with client-retired class and never as wallet offline

vectors.name: Faucet deep-link is not completion
vectors.expect: faucet.completed requires acceptanceId, txHash, authoritativeReceiptId, and finalized finality

vectors.name: Backup restore and tamper
vectors.expect: restored Outbox/Inbox retains idempotency; tampered records are rejected

vectors.name: Privacy and aggregation
vectors.expect: payload has no seed, private key, device secret, bearer token, WalletConnect symmetric key, full signature, private message, PII, account address, or cross-DApp identifier

vectors.name: Canonical delivery fields
vectors.expect: tenant, sequence, effectiveAt, and payloadHash are required; payloadHash is only a SHA-256 integrity reference

vectors.name: Asynchronous ordering
vectors.expect: sequence supports per-pseudonym ordering in Outbox/Inbox without ever gating wallet approval or standard connection
